description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryService class in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin system. It provides a service layer for handling employee salary data, primarily managing an instance of EmployeeSalaryDao used for data access.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryService
classes.description: Service class providing access to employee salary data via the EmployeeSalaryDao.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalaryDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeSalaryDao, creating it if it does not already exist.
